title: OhSINT Investigation
description: A guided OSINT investigation into image metadata, public-source correlation and information disclosure risk.
approach: Used Windows, PowerShell and ExifTool to inspect a challenge image, identify XMP-exif GPS-related metadata and correlate public information.
validation: Completed all seven TryHackMe questions with coaching. A Wi-Fi SSID observation was supplied by the coach and was not independently verified.
outcome: Documented investigative limitations and proposed defensive controls for image-publishing workflows. Those controls have not been deployed or tested.
learned: Distinguish observed evidence from inference; inspect EXIF and XMP; avoid overstating verification.
card_approach: Inspected image metadata and correlated public sources.
card_outcome: Documented exposure risks; defensive controls proposed only.

evidence_checks.result: GPS-related fields identified in XMP-exif using ExifTool
Result supplied by coach; not independently confirmed
Detection, prevention and verification criteria proposed; not deployed

title: Windows Autopilot & Intune enrollment
description: A physical Windows 11 Autopilot lab investigating Microsoft Entra join, user sign-in and Intune management.
approach: Inspected Autopilot profile targeting, enrollment restrictions and ESP settings. Completed user-driven Windows setup, signed in with the selected lab account and verified local device trust and MDM indicators.
validation: On 3 November 2026, the user observed AzureAdJoined = YES, DomainJoined = NO and AzureAdPrt = YES via dsregcmd. The Windows device appeared in Intune with Managed by = Microsoft Intune. These confirm Entra join, user SSO readiness and Intune MDM visibility. ESP completion has not been established.
outcome: Core Microsoft Entra join and Intune MDM enrollment confirmed by user observation. Effective compliance and configuration policy outcomes, application enforcement and actual ESP result remain to be tested.
learned: Validate the device trust state, user PRT and MDM status separately. A reachable desktop alone is insufficient; policy application requires additional per-device verification.
card_approach: Completed user-driven setup and checked dsregcmd plus the Intune device record.
card_validation: Entra join, PRT and Intune MDM confirmed by user checks.
card_outcome: ESP outcome and effective device policy status still open.

evidence_checks.result: Device visible; Managed by = Microsoft Intune
